messages:
DeployBot: [DEPLOY SCHEDULED] runtime-service v2.3.1 -> prod. Change window 2026-03-22 03:00 UTC. Rolling canary 5% EU -> global. Expected duration ~30m. Pinning image to sha:abc123. Rollback target: v2.3.0. Links: https://go/redwood/deploy/12345
Priya (eng-platform): ack. I'll hand off the pin + image verify. Any customer-facing impact to call out?
Sam (support): No planned downtime, but we should prepare a statuspage snippet and an email for dedicated customers in EU. Recent telemetry shows a small spike under similar rollout (2026-02) so let's be explicit about possible brief 5xxs.
Lina (oncall): oncall plan: monitor canary for 10min, if error rate > 1% or latency p95 > 600ms we pause and rollback to v2.3.0. I'll be watching the canary dashboard.
Jared (ops): Ops checklist: preflight health checks ✅, LD/ASG pre-warm ✅, KV cache warmup script queued. In case of rollback we'll run: `./rollback.sh v2.3.0 --force --no-promote` and then pin back to last-stable sha.
Sam (support): Draft statuspage snippet (please review):
```
Status: Degraded performance (scheduled rollout)
Component: runtime-service (prod)
Scheduled window: 2026-03-22 03:00 UTC - 03:30 UTC
Details: We are rolling out runtime-service v2.3.1 to improve memory usage and latency. During the rollout some requests may see brief errors (5xx) or higher latency. We will update as the rollout progresses.
No action required from customers unless they see persistent errors.
```
Marta (docs): Suggest adding a short FAQ line for dedicated/private customers about pinning and rollback behavior so support can paste into replies. "How do I know if my dedicated capacity was affected?" -> explain shading and region tags.
Priya (eng-platform): Good catch. Sam, can you add a dedicated-customer email segment that mentions SLA and that we will notify them if we need to extend the window?
Sam (support): Yep — will add. Draft email snippet: "We are performing a scheduled rollout of runtime-service v2.3.1 on 2026-03-22 03:00 UTC. Expected impact: none for most customers; a small subset may experience brief errors. If your service experiences persistent errors beyond 10 minutes please reply to this message or open a ticket. We'll send a follow-up if we need to extend the window or roll back."
Priya (eng-platform): Plan for when to post statuspage: 10 minutes before the window we post the scheduled snippet, switch to "Under Maintenance" if we hit a rollback or >1% error rate, and post a resolved note after rollout completes.
Lina (oncall): I'll post the live updates in this thread during the canary. Add `@oncall` in the statuspage updates so folks get pager context.
Jared (ops): Also make sure the release notes include the pin sha and the hotfix steps. I'll add an ops-runbook link: https://go/redwood/runbooks/runtime-rollback
Priya (eng-platform): I'll create the pin PR and the release note now, and push the final statuspage text to #statuspage-drafts. Sam, please review the customer email and ping legal if needed for wording.
Sam (support): Will review and post to #statuspage-drafts in 15m. Adding dedicated EU list to the recipients.
Marta (docs): I'll add the FAQ snippet to the rollout release notes and link it in the statuspage.
Priya (eng-platform): TL;DR: deploy scheduled, pin image, statuspage + email drafts ready, oncall rollback threshold = 1% errors or p95 > 600ms. Owners: Priya (pin & release notes), Sam (statuspage & customer emails), Lina (oncall during rollout), Jared (ops rollback runbook), Marta (docs).
DeployBot: UPDATE: preflight checks green. Canary will start at 03:00 UTC.
Lina (oncall): starting watchlist and alert dashboard. Ping here with any anomalies.
Sam (support): posted statuspage draft to #statuspage-drafts: https://go/redwood/ops/statuspage-drafts/6789 — please thumbs up if happy. :thumbsup:
Priya (eng-platform): thumbs up, I'll set the pin at 02:30 UTC and send final go/no-go 20m before the window.
Jared (ops): I'll standby for rollback exec.
Sam (support): emailing dedicated EU list at 02:40 UTC with the prepared snippet.
Priya (eng-platform): thanks team — keep updates short in this thread during the window.
